researcher_decision.statement: 4개 표적 회귀 TextGrid의 경계를 모두 승인한다. 2020–2025에 동일한 기준을 적용하는 단계적 safe-body adoption을 승인하며, 718,364개 후속 발화는 별도 shard로 보존한다. 승인자 ari30.

scope.safe_body_definition: every actual MFA LAB token has an audited r3 candidate pronunciation
scope.followup_definition: utterance contains at least one hold, unresolved policy, unknown, or empty LAB condition
scope.production_alignment_set: pronunciation-safe utterances intersected by the independently approved audio/CSV/alignment-eligibility contract

global_once_only_stages: canonical inventory and readiness stages 01 through 18
safe-body candidate materialization and audit stage 20
researcher approval of targeted boundaries and staged scope

recovery_policy.technical_process_interruption: resume the same release/year database and checkpoint
recovery_policy.individual_audio_or_alignment_failure: preserve exact IDs in follow-up; do not restart the year
recovery_policy.textgrid_or_tier_export_bug: re-export from the preserved r3 database only
recovery_policy.localized_pronunciation_patch: create a new point contract, compute token-to-session impact, and realign only complete affected adaptation units
recovery_policy.global_dictionary_phone_inventory_or_aco: invalidate and realign every completed year affected by the changed contract
recovery_policy.disk_or_sidecar_logging_failure: safe-stop or retry the sidecar; preserve MFA computation and all partial evidence
